issues.problem: Microsoft's FY2024 operating income was about $109.4 billion, not $88.5 billion. The $88.5 billion figure is close to net income ($88.1 billion), so it looks like the two were mixed up.

data.summary: Almost all of it is right. Revenue was $245.1B, up 15.7% from $211.9B. Net income was $88.1B, total assets were $512.2B and cash and cash equivalents were $18.3B. The one error is operating income, which was about $109.4B, not $88.5B.
